epics.description: Support agents need to export the data of a customer account so that they can answer customer requests. The specification defines only this single user story; its format, encoding, access rights, content, and delivery method are still open and must be decided before development.

features.description: Single capability allowing a support agent to export the data of a customer account. Format, encoding and delimiter, access rights, exported content, and size or delivery rules are not yet decided.
features.name: Customer data export

acceptanceCriteria: Given a support agent is viewing a customer account, When the agent triggers the export of that account's data, Then an export of the data of that customer account is produced.
Given a support agent has triggered an export of a customer account, When the export is produced, Then the export contains the data of that customer account only.
stories.aiReadyReason: The export format (CSV, JSON or ZIP), the set of included fields, the roles allowed to export, and the delivery method (browser download or email) are all undecided, so a developer cannot know what the export must contain; which fields and which roles should be included in the customer data export?
stories.description: A support agent can trigger an export of the data of a customer account to answer a customer request. Open points not decided by the specification: the export format (CSV, JSON or a ZIP archive with several files); for CSV, the encoding and delimiter (the project context defines UTF-8 without BOM with semicolons for CSV exports, but the specification leaves it open); which roles may export; which fields are included (orders, invoices, personal data, support history), pending GDPR review; size limits for very large accounts; and whether the file is downloaded in the browser or sent by email.
stories.iWant: to export the data of a customer account
stories.title: Export a customer account's data
